newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - August 28.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - August 28.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:
** The Dow Jones industrial average ended up 17.38 points at 5,711.27 on Tuesday as technology shares rebounded.
** Indonesia is to allow new sugar mills in eastern provinces of the country to market 75 percent of their output and those in the western provinces 50 percent.
** The Jakarta Composite Index fell 3.22 points, or 0.58 percent, to close at 549.52 points on Tuesday following local profit-taking of selected second-liners and big-caps.
** On Wednesday, the Indonesian rupiah was at 2,342.05/42.20 in early trading against an opening of 2,342.00/42.50.
** Property firms Dharmala Intiland and Putra Surya Perkasa following announcements of H1 results.
** Cigarette maker Gudang Garam and biscuits maker Mayora also on announcements of H1 results.
** Matahari Putra Prima on announcement that the firm had revised down its 1996 net profit forecast.
